name: ATRA + Arsenic Trioxide (APL)

institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard guidelines (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Aggressive coagulopathy support until it resolves (fibrinogen, platelets, DIC monitoring).
Differentiation-syndrome prophylaxis/treatment with corticosteroids; hold offending agent for severe cases.
monitoring: QT interval on arsenic trioxide (correct potassium/magnesium).
CBC, coagulation panel, and PML-RARA PCR to confirm molecular remission.

drugs.name: Tretinoin (ATRA)
drugs.notes: All-trans retinoic acid 45 mg/m2/day PO in two divided doses, from clinical suspicion of APL through induction (continued in consolidation cycles). Start before genetic confirmation. Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita, general reference.

drugs.name: Arsenic Trioxide (ATO)
drugs.notes: 0.15 mg/kg IV daily during induction until morphologic remission, then on the consolidation schedule; chemotherapy-free with ATRA for low/intermediate-risk APL. Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita, general reference.
